utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final start time, but I’ll check and let you know. They’re definitely accepting donated tools and repair supplies, and I’ll get the full list too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just let me know the start time and list when you have them, and I can help sort through the donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll send you the start time and full donation list as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I heard it’s getting a few more donations today. I’ll be there at 3 to help with the boxes and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that’s good to hear — it’s really picking up today. I’ll keep an ear out if they need anything else while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. If you hear of any extra boxes or spare parts, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to know—sounds like they’re still gathering tools and parts. I’d appreciate it if you could check what’s still needed and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know. If it helps, I can also work around school drop-off and pickup once you have a time in mind.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye—that helps a lot. I’ll wait for your update on what’s still needed, then we can figure out a time around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — just keep me posted, and I can help out for a bit if it stays low-key.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep it simple and low-key. Just let me know what you need me to do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — could you help set up the front porch and keep an eye on the tools? That should be enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the time and the load list so I can write it down. Once that’s set, I’m good to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and the load list before I say yes? I just want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need the time and the load list before I can confirm anything. Once you send those, I’ll write it down and we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring over the wrench set and screwdriver for the repair drive. What else do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — the tools are the big thing. If anyone else can help at the front porch this Saturday, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help at the front porch this Saturday too — just let me know what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — we’re starting at the front porch this Saturday, and small fixes first would help most. If you can share that with a few neighbors, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and tell them we’re starting at the front porch this Saturday. Small fixes first, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. See you at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s now on Sunday at the community center. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I'll note the community center for Sunday. Let me know what repairs still need doing so I can keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with setup and small fixes. What’s left on the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, as far as I know. I’m happy to help, but I’d feel better once those two roles are clearly assigned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I’ll make sure those two roles get assigned and I’ll update you as soon as they are.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — that would help a lot. Please let me know as soon as they’re set so I can plan the timing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive details to the neighbors and point out the biggest repairs first so everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I might’ve missed some of the details, so I’m glad you’ll keep repeating the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details and make sure the biggest repairs are clear to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. Could you let me know as soon as you find the start time and the flyer?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I find the start time and flyer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll wait to hear back from you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll wait for your update before bringing anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll swing by and see what they still need, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll hold off until I hear what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive details to the neighbors and make sure the biggest repairs are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — we’ve got to gather the tools first, then head to the repair drive at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, I’ll keep telling the neighbors to bring the tools first and head to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got the flyers and repair drive details to send over, and I’ll be there at 3 to help with the boxes and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks—3 works. Please send the details over, and if anything changes, remind me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details over, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re doing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I still need a few helpers. I’m happy to keep it simple—just let me know if you can come.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Bo — I can help with the repair drive on Saturday and sort through what’s been donated. Just let me know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Sam — sorting donations would be a huge help. I’ll let you know what’s still missing before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the exact start time and the full donation list when you can? I’ll gather the tools first and then head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still confirming the exact start time and the full donation list, and I’ll send it as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’ll wait for the details—once you have the start time and donation list, send them over and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I know Gus is bringing tools and someone’s checking the list. What still needs to be done for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We still need a few more helpers this Saturday at the front porch, and we should keep focusing on the small fixes first. If you can spread the word, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll pass that along and tell folks we still need a few more helpers Saturday at the front porch. I’ve only heard the updates second-hand, but I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks—I'm a bit late, but I can help spread the repair drive details around the neighborhood too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Dane—could you point folks to the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive? I’m tracking the locations, and that’s our first stop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll point folks to the front porch this Saturday and spread the word around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got on hand—what supplies do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A simple list should do—I'm aiming for 3 items. If you find anything, let me know and I’ll keep it tidy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll look for a hammer, screwdriver set, and spare tape, and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mara — I’ll have the wrench set and screwdriver ready for you tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks, Gus — I’ll swing by tomorrow afternoon to pick up the tools first, then we can head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll have them ready when you stop by tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Glad to help, Rosa. Just let me know the time for Sunday at the community center and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set. Appreciate you helping out, even for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye out for the time and do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Pia—do you know when the repair drive starts, and is there a flyer with the items they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure on the start time yet, and I haven’t seen a flyer. I’d feel better once we have one person clearly assigned for each end.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — who’s handling the other end right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll swing by the repair drive and see what’s still needed, then I’ll let you know. Seems like folks are bringing in plenty of useful stuff so far.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So there really are plenty of good donations coming in, then? Let me know what’s still needed when you check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll check the list and let you know what they still need. From what I’m hearing, it’s been a pretty solid turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great—if it helps, I can work around school drop-off and pickup. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I can check while I’m out. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear.
